chinook.title: Chinook
chinook.subtitle: Music store
chinook.description: A digital music store: artists, albums, tracks, genres, playlists, customers, employees and five years of invoices (2009–2013).
chinook.source: Chinook sample database by Luis Rocha (MIT License)
examples: Which 5 genres made the most revenue in 2012, and how did each change vs 2011?
Is there a correlation between track length and price?
Which 10 artists have the most tracks?
Show monthly sales for 2013

superhero.title: Superhero
superhero.subtitle: Comic characters
superhero.description: Superheroes with their publishers, powers, attributes, alignment, race, gender, height and weight.
examples: Which publisher has the most superheroes?
What are the 10 most common superpowers?
Show the best heroes
Average height of heroes by alignment

student_club.title: Student Club
student_club.subtitle: Club budgets & events
student_club.description: A university student club: members, majors, events, attendance, budgets, expenses and income.
examples: Which events had the highest attendance?
Total expenses by budget category
How many members are in each major's department?
Which event went most over budget?

formula_1.title: Formula 1
formula_1.subtitle: Races since 1950
formula_1.description: Formula 1 seasons, circuits, races, drivers, constructors, results, qualifying, pit stops and lap times.
formula_1.source: BIRD Mini-Dev (CC BY-SA 4.0), originally the Ergast F1 dataset
examples: Which drivers have the most race wins?
Which constructor scored the most points in 2010?
How many races were held in each country?
What was Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap time ever?

european_football_2.title: European Football
european_football_2.subtitle: Players, teams, matches
european_football_2.description: European club football 2008–2016: leagues, teams, matches, players and 180,000 FIFA player-attribute snapshots. Match event XML columns are omitted in this demo copy.
european_football_2.source: BIRD Mini-Dev (CC BY-SA 4.0), originally the Kaggle European Soccer Database
examples: Show me the best players
Which league had the most goals in the 2015/2016 season?
Average overall rating by preferred foot
Which teams won the most home matches?
